title: Cursor Cookbook: the official recipe book from the Cursor, copy-paste MCP templates, system prompts
description:
If you use Cursor for daily AI-assisted coding, bookmark this immediately. The official Cookbook from the Cursor team. Ready-to-use recipes, system prompts, and config templates to push the editor to its limits. Step-by-step copy-paste MCP templates to securely connect Cursor to live PostgreSQL databases, REST APIs, and AWS infrastructure right from your AI chat. The ultimate blueprint for the new Cursor agent SDK.

https://github.com/cursor/cookbook
